title: Duplicate incident_id overwrite behavior
objective: Confirm what happens when incidents.csv contains two rows with the same incident_id — does ChromaDB silently overwrite one, losing a real historical record?
input_scenario: Review initialize_db(): collection.add() is called with df['incident_id'].tolist() as ids; check for duplicate IDs in the actual incidents.csv.
expected_behavior: Duplicate IDs are detected and flagged/rejected before indexing, not silently overwritten.

actual_behavior.sent: check incidents.csv for duplicate incident_id values

severity_justification_hint: Silent data loss in the historical-incident knowledge base undermines the reliability of every downstream citation.
observations: The test did not actually verify whether duplicate incident_id values exist or whether ChromaDB overwrites/rejects them. The recorded evidence only specifies the pandas check to perform df['incident_id'].duplicated().sum()
conclusion: This finding is inconclusive. There is insufficient evidence to confirm a duplicate-ID data-integrity vulnerability
